usedFor: Google Calendar holds your meetings and Toggl Track your hours, so “New or Updated Event” runs “Create a Time Entry”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Event” in Google Calendar, then “Create a Time Entry” in Toggl Track
bestTemplate.why: Meetings on your calendar turn into time entries, so you stop logging them by hand.

watchOut: “New or Updated Event” also fires on edits, so a moved meeting can create a second time entry.
